note: Regime A path green after two fixes: (1) blocked chain outputs need ReservePolicy/PushPolicy::PerBlockSize (PerTile emits ONE reserve+push per BLOCK, not per tile -> writer hang); (2) sum_of_squares only accumulates tiles element-wise, so Regime A needs a within-tile reduce<SUM,REDUCE_ROW> finalize (accumulate-then-finalize).

Regime B multi-chunk corrupts specific tiles deterministically (bad tiles 304,305,308,309,508,509 for (1,1,32,16384)). Diagnosis: a multi-page cb_reserve_back/cb_wait_front + contiguous N-page access is only legal when the CB page count is a multiple of N and the fifo pointer is N-aligned. Two sources of misalignment: (a) a W-chunk tail whose width differs from the block (Wt not divisible by the chunk), (b) a partial last row-block (ht < BLOCK_HT). Both leave the fifo pointer off-grid so the next full-size access runs past the CB end into the neighbouring CB. Fix: chunk must DIVIDE Wt_core (no tail) and row-blocks are always exactly BLOCK_HT tile-rows (reader clamps phantom tile-rows to the last valid one; the writer emits only valid rows).
Green in both default and --dev mode after the CB-wrap fix (divisor W-chunks + full BLOCK_HT row-blocks with phantom-row clamp).
